explain_eng: Altogether the park covers 170 acres, that’s {{69}} hectares.
explain_tw: 整體而言，這座公園占地170英畝，即69公頃。

explain_eng: There are also several smaller ones, ponds and a {{stream}} that flows through the park.
explain_tw: 公園內還有幾個較小的景點，包括池塘和一條橫貫公園的 stream。

explain_eng: They also collect and analyse {{data}} about the things they see.
explain_tw: 他們也會針對所見的事物收集並分析 data。

explain_eng: The park is a great environment to learn and practice reading a {{map}} and using a compass to navigate around the park.
explain_tw: 這個公園是學習和練習閱讀 map，並使用指南針在公園內導航的良好環境。

explain_eng: That focuses (= concentrates) on your {{visitors}}, I would imagine.
explain_tw: 我認為，這是以您的 visitors 為重點（= 集中注意力）。

explain_eng: We all had a great time on the final boat trip down the {{river}} - that was the real highlight.
explain_tw: 我們在沿著 river 進行的最後一趟船遊中玩得很開心——那才是真正的亮點。

explain_eng: We've decided to plant a poplar tree in the museum {{gardens}}.
explain_tw: 我們已決定在博物館的 gardens 種植一棵楊樹。

explain_eng: Our pancake evening was well attended and made record {{profits}}.
explain_tw: 我們的鬆餅晚會參與人數眾多，並創下 profits 紀錄。

explain_eng: Don't try to do too much that first evening as they'll be tired, so have dinner in the {{house}} or garden rather than eating out.
explain_tw: 剛抵達的第一個晚上別安排太密集的行程，因為他們會很累，建議在 house 或花園裡用餐，而不是外出就餐。

explain_eng: The main entrance to the house has a lot of steps, so you might want to use the {{disabled entry}}. This is on the far side of the house from the car park.
explain_tw: 進入這棟房子的主要入口有很多階梯，因此您可能會想使用 disabled entry。它位於房屋的另一側，與停車場相對。

explain_eng: Children will probably be most interested in the {{adventure playground}}.
explain_tw: 小朋友可能會對 adventure playground 最感興趣。

explain_eng: That's at the northern end of {{the larger lake}}, in a bend on the path that leads to the lake.
explain_tw: 這裡位於 the larger lake 的北端，靠近通往湖泊的小徑彎道處。

explain_eng: The {{kitchen gardens}} are rectangular and surrounded by a wall. They’re to the north-east of the house, quite near the smaller lake.
explain_tw: kitchen gardens 呈長方形，並由圍牆環繞。它們位於房屋的東北側，距離較小的湖泊相當近。

explain_eng: It must’ve been a great feeling to make something appetising out of bits of {{old bread}} that would’ve been thrown away otherwise.
explain_tw: 將原本會丟棄的 old bread 改造成令人食指大動的美食，那種感覺一定很棒。

explain_eng: It might be really good for drug storage in {{hospitals and pharmacies}}.
explain_tw: 這對於hospitals and pharmacies的藥物儲存可能非常有益。

explain_eng: Recent studies indicate that vent populations are actually {{increasing}} globally, though we're still trying to understand why.
explain_tw: 最新的研究指出，vents 種群在全球實際上正在 increasing，儘管我們仍在努力理解原因。

explain_eng: The main challenge in verifying these hypotheses remains the {{technical limitations}} of our equipment - we simply can't monitor these sites as continuously as we'd like.
explain_tw: 驗證這些假說的主要挑戰，仍來自於我們設備的 technical limitations——我們Simply無法像期望的那樣持續監控這些地點。

explain_eng: The bacteria communities found near these vents are particularly unique. Rather than using sunlight as an {{energy source}}, they harness chemical energy from the vent fluids.
explain_tw: 在這些通風口附近發現的細菌群落特別獨特。它們不依賴 sunlight 作為 energy source，而是從通風口流體中獲取化學能。

explain_eng: Our research over the past decade suggests these ecosystems operate {{independently}} of surface conditions.
explain_tw: 我們過去十年的研究顯示，這些生態系統會 independently 於地表條件運作。
